shots.visual: A luxurious silk evening dress tears open dramatically along the seam under glowing chandelier lights.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 哎呀，林小姐的裙子裂開了！

shots.visual: A arrogant woman points mockingly at the woman standing calmly opposite her.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 這種便宜貨也敢穿來晚宴？

shots.visual: A confident woman looks down at her damaged dress with a slight playful smirk.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 小白，消耗點數重構禮服。

shots.visual: A glowing blue holographic system display flashes bright numbers in the air.

lines.speaker: system_boy
lines.text: 點數已扣除，極光高訂生成中。

shots.visual: Dazzling golden light swirls around the woman, instantly transforming the torn dress into a breathtaking slit gown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魔法般的金光瞬間包裹全場！

shots.visual: A villainous woman's eyes open wide in shock, her face pale under the bright lighting.
The heroine steps forward gracefully in her radiant high-fashion gown, revealing a sharp side slit.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 蘇小姐，多謝你的特別剪裁。

shots.visual: The heroine walks past the embarrassed villain with her head held high, flicking her long hair.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 現在，這才是獨一無二的高訂。

shots.visual: An angry woman clenches her fists tighter, trembling in sheer embarrassment.

lines.speaker: su_man
lines.text: 林曉！妳少在這邊裝模作樣！

shots.visual: A handsome CEO standing by a marble column holds a champagne glass, staring intensely at the glowing woman.

lines.speaker: gu_ting
lines.text: 這個女人……到底藏了什麼秘密？

shots.visual: The heroine turns her head slightly and glances directly at the CEO across the room with a playful smile.

lines.speaker: lin_xia
lines.text: 顧總，好戲才剛剛開始呢。

shots.visual: A digital HUD panel flashes red warning text overlaying the ballroom background.

lines.speaker: system_boy
lines.text: 警告！顧霆心跳率突破一百二。

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of the CEO pressing a hand over his suit jacket, his chest heaving, image freezing in warm light.

lines.speaker: gu_ting
lines.text: 該死……心跳怎麼停不下來？
